name: a11y-before-handoff
description: A practical accessibility handoff tool for everyone building digital products.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run package:plugin-assets
scripts.build:plugin: npm run build --workspace @a11y/figma-plugin && npm run package:plugin-assets
scripts.deploy:build: npm run build:plugin && npm run build --workspace @a11y/web && npm run build --workspace @a11y/server
